before: A deletion beforeinput deleted one character at the caret whatever its target range named; a composition that removed a run span refilled that range from the model.
after: A deletion beforeinput anchored at the caret runs one ordinary Backspace or Delete step per character it names; a span the browser removed during a composition reads as erased.
reason: Edits still reach the document through the existing deletion and composition readback lanes, which produce the same tree operations as keyboard Backspace. Shared nodes, offsets, operation shapes and serialization are unchanged; the paragraph-end line break is paint furniture only.
